lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity7
: How did I get here?! {i}When{/i} did I get here?! And what do you think you’re doing?!
lines.zh: : 我怎么会在这儿？！我{i}什么时候{/i}到这儿的？！还有你以为你在干什么？！

lines.en: : A mysterious pop! Just now! Having sex with...the teacher!
lines.zh: : 神秘地「啵」的一声！就在刚刚！在和……老师做爱！

lines.en: : I am so FUCKING STICKY! Come feel me! Words can not properly describe it! And I’m the word girl so you know I’m telling the truth!
lines.zh: : 我他妈黏死了！快来摸摸我！语言根本形容不出来！而我可是语言少女，所以你知道我说的是真的！

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity8
: Is he unconscious?!
lines.zh: : 他昏过去了吗？！

lines.en: : Yes. I did that. It was for a thing. But no! You have to wait until I’m done to have a turn!
lines.zh: : 是的。是我干的。为了某件事。但是不行！你得等我弄完才能轮到你！

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity9
: I don’t want a turn! I want to know how I got here! I went from playing volleyball to wandering through an upside down school to watching {i}you{/i} guys in a matter of like twenty minutes!
lines.zh: : 我才不要轮！我想知道我怎么会在这儿！我从打排球，到在一所上下颠倒的学校里乱逛，再到看着{i}你{/i}们俩——前后也就二十分钟吧！

lines.en: : You jumped! From one world to the next!
lines.zh: : 你跳跃了！从一个世界跳到下一个世界！

lines.en: : I did what?!
lines.zh: : 我什么？！

lines.en: : They’re all on top of one another, you see! And we can move through them!
lines.zh: : 你瞧，它们全都一层叠着一层！而我们能在其中穿行！

lines.en: : You did that! That is what you did! And I knew you would! Or someone would! But it was louder than expected. And I didn’t know when. How are you?
lines.zh: : 你做到了！你就是那么做的！而我就知道你会！或者总有人会！只是动静比预想的大。而且我不知道是什么时候。你现在怎么样？

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity10
: Bad! Very, very bad! And confused! And you should probably stop having sex with Sensei while he is asleep!
lines.zh: : 很糟！非常非常糟！而且很困惑！还有，你最好别再趁 Sensei 睡着的时候跟他做爱了！

lines.en: : He’s not just {i}asleep,{/i} Futaba. He is {i}wandering.{/i} Ethereal! I did that to him with my vagina. My vagina and words. Mostly words. But he was already in the vagina when I used the words. But yes, he’s gone. And also here.
lines.zh: : 他不只是{i}睡着了{/i}，Futaba。他在{i}神游{/i}。飘然物外！是我用我的阴道做到的。我的阴道，还有语言。主要是语言。不过我用语言的时候，他已经在我的阴道里了。总之，他走了。可他也在这里。

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity11
: Can you explain that in a slightly more comprehensible way maybe? I’m seriously freaking out right now.
lines.zh: : 你能不能解释得稍微好懂一点？我现在真的快崩溃了。

lines.en: : You look fine to me. Stripes look good on you. Can I watch when you take your turn next? Trick question- I’m going to watch whether you want me to or not. I have extra eyes right now.
lines.zh: : 我看你挺好的。条纹挺衬你。下次轮到你的时候我能看吗？陷阱题——不管你想不想，我都会看。我现在多长了几只眼睛。

lines.en: : Nodoka, {i}please.{/i}
lines.zh: : Nodoka，{i}求你了{/i}。

lines.en: : Sensei is special. He can do what {i}you{/i} did over and over and over and over again. Or at least kind of? His mind leaves. His body stays. But {i}your{/i} body moved. How did you do that? Are {i}you{/i} special too?
lines.zh: : Sensei 很特别。他能一遍又一遍、一遍又一遍地做{i}你{/i}刚才做的事。至少差不多？他的意识离开了。身体留在这里。可{i}你的{/i}身体是移动了的。你是怎么做到的？{i}你{/i}也很特别吗？

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity12
: Trick question again! Of course you are!
lines.zh: : 又是陷阱题！当然是了！

lines.en: : You are because {i}she{/i} was! And {i}she{/i} had the key to the attic! She was the one who collected the groceries! That supple body, mangled by the cock of time! So special she was!
lines.zh: : 你特别，是因为{i}她{/i}特别！而{i}她{/i}握着阁楼的钥匙！采购日用品的就是她！那具柔软的身体，被时间之鸡巴碾得粉碎！她是那么特别！

lines.en: : What was there?! What did you see?!
lines.zh: : 那里有什么？！你看见了什么？！

: You mentioned it was upside down, yes? Were you? Did you walk on the ceiling or the floor? Was Kyoko there? Did you see her too? What did she say? What did she look like?
lines.zh: : 你说过那里是上下颠倒的，对吧？你呢？你是走在天花板上还是地板上？Kyoko 在吗？你也看见她了吗？她说了什么？她长什么样？

lines.en: : I...don’t even know if it was real...
lines.zh: : 我……甚至不确定那是不是真的……

lines.en: : But...why would your mom be there?
lines.zh: : 可是……你妈妈为什么会在那儿？

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity14

: That’s what I’m trying to figure out, damn it! Do you think I’m here on vacation?! This is work! So don’t burden me with this “real” or “not real” bullshit! It’s all real, Futaba! Some things are just {i}somewhere else!{/i}
lines.zh: : 这正是我要搞清楚的事，该死！你以为我是来度假的吗？！这是工作！所以别拿什么「真的」「假的」这种废话来烦我！一切都是真的，Futaba！有些东西只是在{i}别处{/i}而已！

lines.en: : Nodoka...please calm down...you’re scaring me...
lines.zh: : Nodoka……请冷静一点……你吓到我了……

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity15
: Hm. You know, maybe you {i}do{/i} look different? Paler.
lines.zh: : 嗯。话说回来，你看起来{i}确实{/i}有点不一样？更苍白了。

lines.en: : How do I know you’re the real Futaba? What’s my favorite number? Hint — it’s the same number as my vaginal depth in inches. You should know. A friend would know.
lines.zh: : 我怎么知道你是不是真的 Futaba？我最喜欢的数字是多少？提示——和我阴道的英寸深度是同一个数字。你应该知道。朋友会知道。

lines.en: : Actually, forget my vagina. It’s full of Sensei’s milk right now anyway. You don’t like milk. You’re lactose intol- wait, no. That’s Otoha. Do you like milk? What kind of milk do you like?
lines.zh: : 算了，别管我的阴道。反正现在里面全是 Sensei 的奶。你不喜欢牛奶。你乳糖不耐——等等，不对。那是 Otoha。你喜欢牛奶吗？你喜欢哪种奶？

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity16
: Forget the milk! I’ll explain everything!
lines.zh: : 别管牛奶了！我来把一切都解释清楚！

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity15
: What you experienced was no illusion. You wandered through a gate. Or perhaps a gate was opened for you. Either way, gate. And that gate took you from {i}there{/i} to {i}there{/i} to {i}here.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你经历的并不是幻觉。你穿过了一道门。或者说，有人为你打开了一道门。不管怎样，都是门。而那道门把你从{i}那里{/i}带到{i}那里{/i}，又带到{i}这里{/i}。

lines.en: : But here’s the rub, Futaba — I can’t go through those things. I can’t find any. But I know they’re there because she {i}says{/i} they’re there.
lines.zh: : 但问题在于，Futaba——我没法穿过那些东西。我一扇都找不到。但我知道它们就在那儿，因为她{i}说{/i}它们在。

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity16
: And she isn’t crazy! Neither am I! They exist! We can go anywhere we want! We just have to figure out how and when!
lines.zh: : 而她没有疯！我也没有！它们确实存在！我们可以去任何想去的地方！我们只需要弄清楚怎么做、什么时候做！

lines.en: : And with people like you and the guy who just came in me five hundred times, that should be doable!
lines.zh: : 有你这样的人，再加上刚刚在我里面射了五百次的那家伙，这应该办得到！

lines.en: : But, Nodoka...I didn’t even do anything...
lines.zh: : 可是，Nodoka……我什么都没做啊……

lines.en: : I seriously just...got tossed around a few times...are you sure I didn’t just...walk in here? You were clearly very busy, so...it’s possible you didn’t notice?
lines.zh: : 我真的只是……被甩来甩去几下……你确定我不是就这么走进来的吗？你当时显然很忙，所以……有可能你没注意到？

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity17
: That’s not possible at all. I see everything. You went “pop.” I heard it myself. And then we screamed. Do you remember that? Why would you scream if you walked in? You wouldn’t. That’s dumb.
lines.zh: : 那完全不可能。我什么都看得见。你是「啵」的一声出现的。我亲耳听到的。然后我们俩尖叫了。你记得吗？如果你只是走进来，为什么要尖叫？你不会的。那太蠢了。

lines.en: : Maybe I...blacked out like Sensei does?...And {i}that’s{/i} why I can’t remember? Let me ask Molly and Yasu. They’ll know what-
lines.zh: : 也许我……像 Sensei 那样昏过去了？……{i}所以{/i}才记不起来？让我去问 Molly 和 Yasu。她们会知道——

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity18
: Leave that damn fanatic out of this! Her fucking sermon is what pushed me into this rabbit hole in the first place and now I can’t fucking climb out of it, Futaba!
lines.zh: : 别把那个该死的狂信徒扯进来！就是她那该死的布道把我推进了这个兔子洞，现在我他妈爬都爬不出来，Futaba！

lines.en: : She only knows a part of the truth! But this hole is deeper than that!
lines.zh: : 她只知道一部分真相！可这个洞比那深得多！

lines.en: : We’re talking thousands- no, millions! {i}Billions{/i} of universes smushed together like a fucking mille crepe and she has the audacity to claim there are only {i}two?!{/i} TWO?!?!?!?!
lines.zh: : 我们说的是几千个——不，几百万个！{i}几十亿个{/i}宇宙，像他妈的千层蛋糕一样压在一起，而她居然敢说只有{i}两个？！{/i}两个？！？！？！？！

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity19

: She did help a little bit, though. Albeit mostly unintentionally. But that’s just because I’m a fucking genius and decided to go through some older notes. They took a while to find, but they were there.
lines.zh: : 不过她确实帮了一点忙。虽然基本是无意的。但那只是因为我是个他妈的天才，决定去翻一些旧笔记。找起来花了点时间，但它们确实在那儿。

lines.en: : And I’m really glad they were because the only ground I’ve broken lately has been all about Akira’s sexual history and that is only relevant in regard to {i}this{/i} world. Probably. That’s why I fucked him into a coma.
lines.zh: : 而我真高兴它们在，因为我最近唯一的突破全都是关于 Akira 的性经历的，而那大概只跟{i}这个{/i}世界有关。大概吧。所以我把他操到昏迷了。

lines.en: : Akira?...
lines.zh: : Akira？……

lines.en: : Well, I guess Futaba knows my name now too...
lines.zh: : 好吧，看来 Futaba 现在也知道我的名字了……

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity20
: Ah! Welcome back. Where did you go? What’d you see? Futaba went too. That one wasn’t my fault, though. She managed to do it on her own. She’s so very, very, very very very very very smart!
lines.zh: : 啊！欢迎回来。你去哪儿了？看见了什么？Futaba 也去了。不过那次可不怪我。她是自己做到的。她真的、真的、真的真的真的真的非常聪明！

lines.en: : I didn’t {i}go{/i} anywhere. And I’d really appreciate it if you could never say any of that stuff to me again.
lines.zh: : 我哪儿都没{i}去{/i}。还有，如果你能永远别再跟我说这些，我会感激不尽。

lines.en: : Yeah, I can’t make that promise. But if it’s any consolation, I took very good care of you while you were unconscious!
lines.zh: : 嗯，这个承诺我做不到。不过算是有个安慰——你昏迷的时候我把你照顾得很好！

lines.en: : I even licked the drool off. It wasn’t very flavorful. Also, I might be pregnant now. Let’s come up with a name together!
lines.zh: : 我连口水都舔干净了。味道不怎么样。另外，我现在可能怀孕了。我们一起想个名字吧！

lines.en: scene black
: I’ll go get my notebook! Please hold!
lines.zh: : 我去拿笔记本！请不要挂断！

lines.en: : Nodoka, wait-
lines.zh: : Nodoka，等等——

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity21
Futaba tries her best to fill me in on exactly what I’ve woken up to, but...I’m not sure I understand.
lines.zh: Futaba 尽力向我说明我一醒来面对的到底是什么，但……我不确定自己听懂了。

lines.en: And so I find myself now in the midst of another one of Nodoka’s manic rants as she rattles off a bunch of baby names with my cum still smeared all over her lower body.
lines.zh: 于是我现在就处在 Nodoka 又一次的狂躁长篇大论之中——她喋喋不休地报出一串婴儿名字，而我的精液还糊在她下半身。

lines.en: I have no idea how {i}long{/i} I was out, but I imagine it was at least an hour based on how exhausted I feel and...how gross she looks.
lines.zh: 我不知道自己昏了{i}多久{/i}，但从我有多疲惫、以及……她看起来有多恶心来推断，至少有一个小时。

lines.en: : Are you really going to...list baby names instead of talking more about how I mysteriously just...appeared in this room with you two?
lines.zh: : 你真的打算……列婴儿名字，而不是继续谈谈我是怎么莫名其妙就……出现在你们俩这个房间里的吗？

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity22

: Yes. I’ll begin with the first names of some famous writers since Akira and I both enjoy writing and so will our child. Isaac. Orson. Octavia. Mary. Alastair. Philip. Kurt. Margaret. Jules. Douglas. Samuel.
lines.zh: : 对。我先从一些著名作家的名字开始，因为 Akira 和我都喜欢写作，我们的孩子也会喜欢。Isaac。Orson。Octavia。Mary。Alastair。Philip。Kurt。Margaret。Jules。Douglas。Samuel。

lines.en: : Out of that list, I’d recommend Orson since it would cover both Welles and Scott Card.
lines.zh: : 在这份名单里，我推荐 Orson，因为它能同时涵盖 Welles 和 Scott Card。

lines.en: : But I’m also willing to land on Philip if we can tack on the middle name Kurt since we already got the Dick part out of the way. Fun times, right?
lines.zh: : 不过如果中间名能加上 Kurt，我也愿意选 Philip，毕竟 Dick 那部分我们已经处理掉了。有意思吧，对不对？

lines.en: : Nodoka...if you know something, please tell us. Because the whole reason I even came to the beach in the first place is to investigate weird time stuff.
lines.zh: : Nodoka……如果你知道什么，请告诉我们。因为我来海滩的全部理由，就是要调查那些诡异的时间现象。

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity23
: Are you no longer mad at me for forcing you to recollect all of the sex you had with one of my favorite poets?
lines.zh: : 你不再生我的气了吧？我逼你回忆起你和我最喜欢的诗人之一做过的所有爱。

lines.en: : {i}What?{/i}
scene nodokapostnutclarity24
: And are {i}you{/i} no longer mad at me for forcing you to recollect all of the sex you had with our teacher?
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}也不再生我的气了吧？我逼你回忆起你和我们老师做过的所有爱。

lines.en: : Of course I’m mad! I’ve just never had to deal with teleportation before, so excuse me if I’m prioritizing that over our friendship right now!
lines.zh: : 我当然生气！我只是从来没处理过瞬移这种事，所以抱歉，我现在把它看得比我们的友情更优先！

lines.en: : Lucky. I have to deal with that at least once per week.
lines.zh: : 真幸运。我每周至少得处理一次。

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity25
: Wrong! You do not {i}teleport,{/i} Akira! You slip into a mental state somewhere between {i}conscious{/i} and {i}unconscious{/i} and act on impulse and instinct rather than interest!
lines.zh: : 错！你不是在{i}瞬移{/i}，Akira！你是滑进了一种介于{i}清醒{/i}与{i}昏迷{/i}之间的精神状态，凭冲动和本能而非兴趣行事！

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity26
: Or at least that’s what {i}most{/i} would believe. But {i}most{/i} are not Nodoka Nagasawa. And Nodoka Nagasawa thinks she knows what’s {i}really{/i} going on here.
lines.zh: : 至少{i}大多数人{/i}会这么相信。但{i}大多数人{/i}不是 Nodoka Nagasawa。而 Nodoka Nagasawa 认为自己知道这里{i}真正{/i}在发生什么。

lines.en: : So if I’m not just on auto-pilot when I black out...what do {i}you{/i} think is actually happening?
lines.zh: : 那如果我昏过去的时候不只是在自动驾驶……{i}你{/i}觉得实际发生的是什么？

lines.en: : It’s still auto-pilot in a sense. Just it isn’t instinct or impulse guiding you.
lines.zh: : 某种意义上还是自动驾驶。只是引导你的不是本能或冲动。

lines.en: : It’s {i}memory.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是记忆。{/i}

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity27
: December 28th — I found it. A letter from another me, tucked away in a place that God himself could never find.
lines.zh: : 12 月 28 日——我找到了。另一个我写的一封信，藏在一个连上帝都找不到的地方。

lines.en: : I didn’t know where to look until I wrote it. But the moment I did, and the moment I left, I felt a presence within me as if it had emptied everything else out.
lines.zh: : 在写下它之前，我不知道该去哪里找。可我一写完、一离开，就感觉到体内有个存在，仿佛它把其他一切都清空了。

lines.en: : I was following myself. I had carried this cross before. And it did not matter how many times my knees would buckle along the way as I had already reached the end once.
lines.zh: : 我在追随我自己。我以前背过这副十字架。路上膝盖会跪软多少次都不要紧，因为我已经走到过一次终点。

lines.en: : But when the new end finally came, it was the beginning — for the words were the same...
lines.zh: : 可当新的终点终于到来时，它却是起点——因为那些字句一模一样……

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity28
: But the crescent-moon shaped coffee stain in the upper right corner was now in the bottom left.
lines.zh: : 只是右上角那块新月形的咖啡渍，现在跑到了左下角。

lines.en: : So-
lines.zh: : 所以——

lines.en: : {i}Don’t you idiots get it?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你们这群白痴还不明白吗？{/i}

lines.en: : It’s all a broken record. We’re {i}repeating.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这一切就是一张磨损的唱片。我们在{i}重复{/i}。

lines.en: : Everything we do, and everything we think is not the result of conscious thought, but a predetermined script that we’re simply-
lines.zh: : 我们做的一切、想的一切，都不是有意识思考的结果，而是一份预先写好的剧本，我们只是在——

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity29
scene nodokapostnutclarity30
: N-Nodoka? Are you okay? What’s going on?
lines.zh: : N……Nodoka？你没事吧？发生什么了？

lines.en: : These...fucking headaches! Every day! They won’t stop! I can’t...think! Or rather...{i}something{/i}...doesn’t {i}want{/i} me to think!
lines.zh: : 这些……该死的头痛！每天都来！停不下来！我没办法……思考！或者说……有{i}什么东西{/i}……不{i}想{/i}让我思考！

lines.en: She...figured all that out?
lines.zh: 她……把那些都想明白了？

lines.en: All on her own?...
lines.zh: 全靠她自己？……

lines.en: : NGH.....GAAAAAH!!!!! FUCK!!!!!!
scene nodokapostnutclarity31
: Nodoka?!
lines.zh: : Nodoka？！

lines.en: : FUCK! FUCK FUCK FUCK!
lines.zh: : 操！操操操！

lines.en: : Do you...need an ambulance?!
lines.zh: : 你……需要叫救护车吗？！

lines.en: She knocks something over but I don’t care to look at what it is right now since I know this is bigger than that. And that...worries me.
lines.zh: 她碰倒了什么东西，但我不想去看那是什么，因为我知道眼前的事比那更大。而这……让我担忧。

lines.en: She’s so close...but {i}something{/i} really is trying to stop her from figuring things out. And I’ve never...
lines.zh: 她已经那么接近了……可真的有{i}什么东西{/i}在阻止她弄明白。而我从来没……

lines.en: I don’t...
lines.zh: 我也不……

lines.en: I have no idea what will happen if she keeps fighting back against it.
lines.zh: 我不知道如果她继续这样对抗下去，会发生什么。

lines.en: : I don’t...need an ambulance! I need answers!
lines.zh: : 我不需要……救护车！我需要答案！

lines.en: : I can’t...end up like her! I can’t! I won’t! I...NGAAAAH! FUCK YOU, BRAIN! FUCK YOU, GOD! YOU CAN’T...HIDE...FOREVER!!!!
lines.zh: : 我不能……落得和她一样的下场！我不能！我不会！我……嘎啊啊！去你的，大脑！去你的，上帝！你不可能……永远……躲下去！！！！

lines.en: : I have to...do something about this. She’s clearly not well.
lines.zh: : 我得……做点什么。她显然状态不对。

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity32

: I’m...fine! It’s everyone else who’s unwell! You’re all...still whole! You walk so...unburdened by the weight of your other selves! You think you’re free, but you’re not! You’re actors! Characters! It’s all happened before!
lines.zh: : 我……没事！不正常的是你们其他人！你们全都……还是完整的！你们走起路来……毫无其他自我的重负！你们以为自己是自由的，其实不是！你们是演员！是角色！这一切全都发生过！

lines.en: : Come on...let’s get you dressed and back to your room, okay? Your...research or whatever it is can wait until tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 好了……我们先把衣服穿好，送你回房间，好吗？你的……研究还是什么，可以等到明天。

lines.en: : A...Akira! You know too! I...can tell! You know...I’m not insane! But she...she never had that! She never had...someone like you!
lines.zh: : A……Akira！你也知道！我……看得出来！你知道……我没有疯！可她……她从来没拥有过这个！她从来没……遇到过像你这样的人！

lines.en: scene nodokapostnutclarity33
: Everything...I do...NGAAAAAH! It’s all...to break the mold!...To liberate us!
lines.zh: : 我所做的一切……嘎啊啊！都是为了打破模具！……为了解放我们！

lines.en: : You believe me!!! I know you do!!!!
lines.zh: : 你相信我！！！我知道你相信！！！！

lines.en: : Nodoka, come on. You have to get cleaned up before you put your swimsuit back on.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，别这样。你得先擦干净才能把泳衣穿回去。

lines.en: : {i}Don’t...touch me! I’m not done with him! He needs to tell me what he saw! Where he WENT!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}别……碰我！我还没和他完事！他得告诉我他看见了什么！他去了哪里！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’ll tell you MY story again, okay? Tomorrow. You need to rest right now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我再把我的故事讲给你听，好吗？明天。你现在需要休息。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Akira!!! Let me stay!!! Let me stay!!!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Akira！！！让我留下！！！让我留下！！！{/i}

lines.en: scene black
I really didn’t go anywhere.
lines.zh: 我真的哪儿都没去。

lines.en: When I passed out, it was all just dark.
lines.zh: 我昏过去的时候，眼前只有一片漆黑。

lines.en: And the sound of a creaking bed, just as it had done so many times in the past, kept me suspended somewhere between conscious and unconscious.
lines.zh: 而床板吱呀作响的声音，就像过去无数次那样，把我悬在清醒与昏迷之间。

lines.en: I felt every twitch...
lines.zh: 我感受到了每一次抽搐……

lines.en: Every scratch...
lines.zh: 每一道抓痕……

lines.en: Every ejaculation...
lines.zh: 每一次射精……

lines.en: Or maybe I didn’t.
lines.zh: 也许我并没有。

lines.en: Maybe I just remember them.
lines.zh: 也许我只是记得它们。

lines.en: I have to talk to Ayane.
lines.zh: 我得跟 Ayane 谈一谈。
